content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on a contractual basis in ECHS Polyclinic Pune, ECHS Polyclinic Pune (Nyati), and Regional Centre ECHS Pune for a period up to 31 March 2027, renewable for an additional period of one year or till attaining the maximum age subject to performance. Medical Officer and Dental Officers will carry out 10 days on-the-job training and obtain a certificate from the Officer-in-Charge polyclinic before signing the contract, during which time onboarding will remain unpaid and as a mandatory requirement. Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen. Reservation applies as 60% of total posts of Med Staff and 70% of total post of Para Med Staff and Non-Med Staff for Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Pune Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the official website www.echs.gov.in. Fill out the application form with all required details. Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials of educational qualifications, two copies of PAN Card, two copies of Aadhar Card, work experiences, copy of PPO, Discharge Book and Service Records (for Ex-Servicemen), and Certificate of Registration with Medical Council (for Medical and Para Medical Staff). Send the completed application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Pune by Registered or Ordinary Post. Ensure the application is received at Station Cell ECHS, Pune, HQ Dakshin Maharashtra & Goa Sub Area, Near War Memorial, Southern Command, Ghorpadigaon, Pune, Maharashtra, Pin Code: 411001 by 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. Is the ECHS Pune recruitment for permanent jobs or on contract?
faq.answer: The recruitment is on a contractual basis for a period up to 31 March 2027, and it is renewable for an additional period of one year or till attaining the maximum age subject to performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who receives reservation preferences in the ECHS Pune selection?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen. Reservation is maintained at 60% of total posts for Medical Staff and 70% of total posts for Para Medical and Non-Medical Staff for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 24 October 2026. Applications received after 24 October 2026 will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date and reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held on 30 October 2026 at HQ Dakshin Maharashtra & Goa Sub Area, Pune. Eligible candidates must report at 0830 AM sharply on 30 October 2026, and the interview will be held between 0900 hours to 1500 hours.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be enclosed with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, two copies of PAN Card, two copies of Aadhar Card, work experience certificates, copy of PPO, Discharge Book and Service Records (for Ex-Servicemen), and Certificate of Registration with Medical Council (for Medical and Para Medical Staff).
